description_en: Updates a scene orchestration interaction rule
name: UpdateSceneRule

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scene orchestration interaction rule. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html operation to obtain the interaction rule ID
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html接口获取场景联动规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the scene orchestration interaction rule. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则的名称。支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度限制为1~30个字符
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.example: {"action":[{"params":{"content":"${metadata.formattedTime}: 收到定时消息","title":"钉钉机器人通知","webHook":"https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=xxxxxxxxx"},"uri":"action/dingtalk/robot"}],"trigger":{"params":{"cron":"0 * * * * ? 2020","cronType":"quartz_cron"},"uri":"trigger/timer"},"type":"IFTTT"}
parameters.help_en: The content of the interaction rule. For details about the format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/171059.html
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则内容。格式详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/171059.html
parameters.name: rule_content

parameters.example: 定时发送消息到钉钉机器人
parameters.help_en: The description of the scene orchestration interaction rule. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则描述。长度不超过100个字符
parameters.name: rule_description

Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
